text: can you add the gizmo for when extruding to set the thickness of the face that comes when extruding in. like so i can cut into a tire without cutting through it entirely
resolution: Added an extrude-depth gizmo that drags along a face's NORMAL, so you can sink a recess into an angled face (a tire sidewall) without cutting through. The existing move gizmo only drags along world X/Y/Z, which can't push straight into a non-axis-aligned face. Now a single selected face in the move tool shows an orange double-ended arrow along its normal (meshGizmo NormalHandle + pickNormalHandle hit-test): pull out = extrude the face, push in = inset/cut a recess. Implementation: GizmoHit gained an optional dir; onDown hit-tests the normal arrow before the world gizmo and starts a move drag whose direction is the face normal (frozen screen frame via axisScreen(normal)); the move-drag branch uses g.hit.dir instead of AXIS_DIR[axis], reusing the same snap-to-step math, and shows a '↕ depth ±Nu' readout (negative = sunk into the surface). Enabled mirror planes still apply so insets stay symmetric. Verified: full hmsc-int cart bundles clean; editMesh suite 65/65 (logic rides the already-tested translateVerts). Committed 0ba41b465.
